student: TinyPolicy: independent 6-channel CNN + bag-of-words language encoder + proprio MLP + action MLP
teacher_targets: official teacher action cache for Spatial train samples; Object uses ground-truth loss because teacher is not trained for Object
limitations: Student CNN was trained from scratch and is intentionally a minimal proof-of-concept, not a production VLA.
Language is a fixed vocabulary bag-of-words representation over the 20-task offline protocol.
No closed-loop simulator success was run.
